_note: MOCK CONTENT. Templates for the employer-nudge message generator. Placeholders in {curly braces} get filled from the logged-in user + their claim at render time.

EPF-KYC-404.subject: PF withdrawal blocked — pending KYC approval on your end
EPF-KYC-404.body: Hi {employerContactOrHR}, I've filed my PF withdrawal (UAN {uan}, claim {claimId}) and it was rejected because my KYC (Aadhaar/PAN/Bank) is still pending your approval on the EPFO employer portal, under 'Member KYC Approval'. Could you approve it at your end this week? Once approved I don't need to refile — it resumes automatically. Thanks!

EPF-EXIT-DATE.subject: Request to mark my date of exit on EPFO
EPF-EXIT-DATE.body: Hi {employerContactOrHR}, my PF claim (UAN {uan}, claim {claimId}) was rejected because my date of exit hasn't been marked on EPFO yet. My last working day was {lastWorkingDate}. Could you please mark this on the employer portal so my withdrawal can proceed? Thanks for the help.

EPF-NAME-MISMATCH.subject: Need a Joint Declaration to correct my name on EPFO
EPF-NAME-MISMATCH.body: Hi {employerContactOrHR}, my PF claim (UAN {uan}) was rejected because my name on EPFO doesn't exactly match my Aadhaar. I'd like to raise a Joint Declaration to correct it to '{correctedName}' — could you co-sign this from your side when I submit it? Thanks.

note_for_ui: Only render this generator when the claim's actor is 'employer' (see rejection-codes.json). For self-fixable codes (bank/IFSC, Form 15G, duplicate UAN), there's no employer to nudge — hide the button rather than showing it disabled.
